verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a back-office and compliance platform with renewal-like obligations and deadlines, so agent-driven deadline monitoring through an API is a fair question for this product. The evidence only shows a UI compliance dashboard listing upcoming deadlines and actions. Nothing documents a public API, and the probes for OpenAPI specs and llms.txt all returned 404, so there is no evidence an agent could monitor renewals and act on them programmatically.
